INSERT INTO mrp_unallocated_quantity (run_id, batch_id, demand_key, source_date, attempted_schedule_date, quantity, reason_code, status, resolved_schedule_date, revision) VALUES

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mrp_unallocated_quantity WHERE run_id=#{runId} ORDER BY demand_key, source_date

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mrp_unallocated_quantity ORDER BY demand_key, source_date, id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM mrp_unallocated_quantity WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY demand_key, source_date

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mrp_unallocated_quantity u WHERE u.run_id=#{runId} AND u.status='RESOLVED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mrp_terminal_demand d WHERE d.run_id=u.run_id AND d.terminal_type <> 'MACHINE_OUTPUT' AND (u.demand_key=CONCAT(d.factory_code,'|',d.root_material_code,'|', d.terminal_material_code,'|',d.terminal_type,'|',d.supply_mode,'|',DATE_FORMAT(d.source_month,'%Y-%m')) OR u.demand_key=CONCAT(d.root_material_code,'|',d.terminal_material_code,'|', d.terminal_type,'|',d.supply_mode,'|',DATE_FORMAT(d.source_month,'%Y-%m'))))
mapper.delete: DELETE u FROM mrp_unallocated_quantity u WHERE u.run_id=#{runId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mrp_terminal_demand d WHERE d.run_id=u.run_id AND d.terminal_type <> 'MACHINE_OUTPUT' AND (u.demand_key=CONCAT(d.factory_code,'|',d.root_material_code,'|', d.terminal_material_code,'|',d.terminal_type,'|',d.supply_mode,'|',DATE_FORMAT(d.source_month,'%Y-%m')) OR u.demand_key=CONCAT(d.root_material_code,'|',d.terminal_material_code,'|', d.terminal_type,'|',d.supply_mode,'|',DATE_FORMAT(d.source_month,'%Y-%m'))) )
